message.content:
```yaml
code_suggestions:
- relevant_file: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/kk-packet-approval.sh
  language: |
    bash
  existing_code: |
    delivery=$3 actor=$4 device=$5 digest=$6 head=$7 base=$8 policy=$9 revision=${10} seen=${11} supersede=${12} lease=${13:-}
    [ -z "$lease" ] || [ "$delivery" = force-push ] || fail "a lease is for force-push only"
  suggestion_content: |
    `lease` is a new user-supplied argument that flows straight into `--lease "$lease"` and the gatekeeper's force-push, but unlike `digest` and `device` it is never validated against an expected shape (a commit SHA). Add an explicit format check so malformed or unexpected values are rejected before being used as a force-push lease.
  improved_code: |
    delivery=$3 actor=$4 device=$5 digest=$6 head=$7 base=$8 policy=$9 revision=${10} seen=${11} supersede=${12} lease=${13:-}
    [ -z "$lease" ] || [ "$delivery" = force-push ] || fail "a lease is for force-push only"
    [ -z "$lease" ] || printf '%s' "$lease" | grep -qE '^[0-9a-f]{7,64}$' || fail "'$lease' is not a commit sha"
  one_sentence_summary: |
    Validate the lease argument's format.
  label: |
    security

- relevant_file: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/review-packet/review_packet/model.clj
  language: |
    clojure
  existing_code: |
    packet (cond-> packet
                 since-review (assoc-array :since-review (since-facts since-review step-paths files hunk-index))
                 (chain-break chain since-review remote) (assoc-array :chain-break (chain-break chain since-review remote))
                 (seq history) (assoc-array :history (vec history)))]
  suggestion_content: |
    `(chain-break chain since-review remote)` is invoked twice inside the `cond->`, once for the test and once for the value, duplicating the work and risking the two calls silently diverging if the function is ever changed. Bind it once and reuse the value.
  improved_code: |
    cb (chain-break chain since-review remote)
        packet (cond-> packet
                 since-review (assoc-array :since-review (since-facts since-review step-paths files hunk-index))
                 cb (assoc-array :chain-break cb)
                 (seq history) (assoc-array :history (vec history)))]
  one_sentence_summary: |
    Avoid recomputing chain-break twice.
  label: |
    general

- relevant_file: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/review-feedback/ui/review_feedback/approval.cljs
  language: |
    clojure
  existing_code: |
    (when (:chain-break v) [:dt "Chain break"]) (when (:chain-break v) [:dd (:chain-break v)])
       (when (:remote-head v) [:dt "Remote head"])
       (when (:remote-head v) [:dd.ap-mono (str (:remote-head v) (when (:remote-ref v) (str " (" (:remote-ref v) ")")))])
  suggestion_content: |
    `(:chain-break v)` and `(:remote-head v)` are each evaluated twice to conditionally emit a `:dt`/`:dd` pair, which is redundant and easy to get out of sync if one branch is edited without the other. Combine each pair under a single `when` returning a list of both elements.
  improved_code: |
    (when (:chain-break v) (list [:dt "Chain break"] [:dd (:chain-break v)]))
       (when (:remote-head v)
         (list [:dt "Remote head"]
               [:dd.ap-mono (str (:remote-head v) (when (:remote-ref v) (str " (" (:remote-ref v) ")")))]))
  one_sentence_summary: |
    Deduplicate repeated conditional checks.
  label: |
    general
```
